keyFindings.description: The test's first condition requires an install to land on the issue's volume 'through one of the variables the runtime actually sets for you' and lists nine. The worked case (:170-181) and this round's INFRA-43 note (:41-48, 'judged by both conditions ... the root lands under /legion') sanction the Dispatch harness at /legion/harness (INFRA-43 :69-70). That path is under none of the nine: the XDG homes and TMPDIR are under /legion/scratch (manifest.go:701, :730-737), Go's caches under /legion/go (:806-807), uv's under /legion/uv. Read as written, the canonical test classifies its own worked case as the withheld capability ('It is the withheld capability when either condition fails', :93). The ground the page gives for the condition (:153-168) is the issue's volume against the container's filesystem, which /legion/harness meets. Fix in one place: state condition 1 as landing on the issue's volume (under /legion), with the nine variables as where a tool's own cache already goes; or move the harness under a listed root and update INFRA-43. Keep the bundle identical.
